convertibility_reason: No indicators used - pure price comparison logic. Simple entry/exit with fixed SL/TP. No external libraries. No custom indicators. All logic is self-contained and straightforward to replicate in Python.

other_exits: SL/TP only - no other exit logic; position held until SL or TP hit

custom_logic_notes: Time-gated strategy: trades only at hour==TradeTime (default 18:00). Once a trade is placed, cantrade flag is set false, preventing further trades until hour>TradeTime (next day). Uses H1 Open prices at bar indexes t1 (default 7) and t2 (default 2) to compare: if Open[7] > Open[2]+delta*pip → sell (price rose too much relative to recent bar); if Open[7]+delta*pip < Open[2] → buy (price dropped too much). This is a mean-reversion breakout filter on hourly opens. The cantrade flag resets only when the hour advances past TradeTime, ensuring at most one trade per day. Note: SL=2000 pips is extremely wide relative to TP=200 pips, giving a 1:10 risk-reward ratio. The delta parameter (default 70) is in points, not pips, so on a 5-digit broker delta=70 means 7 pips.
python_conversion_notes: No indicator handles needed - only CopyOpen for H1 bars. The time gate (hour==TradeTime) and cantrade flag are simple state variables. Position check maps to checking if any open position exists for the symbol. The filling type FOK may need adjustment depending on broker support. The delta threshold should use point_size from symbol info. Ensure H1 bar indexing is correct when using array_as_series (index 0=current bar, 7=7 bars ago). The SL/TP values are in points (not pips), so on 5-digit EURUSD: TP=200 points = 20 pips, SL=2000 points = 200 pips. Watch for the cantrade reset logic: it resets when hour>TradeTime, not at midnight, which means if TradeTime=18, cantrade resets at 19:00.
